text:
priya: heads up - CI started failing for release pipeline after last night's KMS rotation. lots of 'access denied' on decrypt, plus SAST alerts spiked around the same time. raising here to correlate.
alex: details? which job and error snippet?
priya: job `release/artifact-verify` on prod. error: `ForbiddenOperation: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/ef12-3456: not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt`
sam: that sounds like either key policy change or missing grant for the CI role. our rotation job should reapply grants but there's a known race where alias rebinds before grants are created.
marie: SAST spike - I'm seeing ~120 new findings flagged as 'proto-gen serialization' in the same window around 03:05 UTC. scanner metadata says ruleset v12.4 deployed at 03:01 by `ci-scan-updater` bot.
rohan: taggin' vuln-scanner-bot - can you confirm what rules changed in v12.4?
vuln-scanner-bot: ruleset v12.4 deployed by ci-scan-updater (sha: a1b2c3). Added fingerprints for generated proto files and tightened regex for hard-coded-keys.
sec-oncall: potential false-positive storm + KMS denial = operational incident. priya, what's blast radius? any customer-facing failures?
priya: only CI artifact verification and nightly canaries failed. one customer canary rollback but no production data loss.
alex: triage plan: 1) confirm KMS grants + key policy 2) reapply missing grants if any 3) backfill audit evidence for the gap 4) isolate SAST noise to ruleset change and handle suppressions.
sam: run `aws kms list-grants --key-id <key> --query Grants[?GranteePrincipal=='arn:aws:iam::123456:role/ci-release-role']` to check. priya can you run that?
priya: ran it — returned empty. list-grants shows only `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/old-deploy-role`. looks like the role rename during onboarding caused the grant to miss.
marie: ok SAST: the new fingerprints were broad. I'll revert the ruleset to v12.3 for now and open a targeted fingerprint PR that uses file checksums rather than path globs.
rohan: after we revert SAST rules, let's run a noise-warning job to detect sudden FP surges in future (alert if >50 new matches in 15m).
sec-oncall: good. for audit backfill: export CloudTrail, pipeline logs, and include `aws sts get-caller-identity` outputs from CI job attempts. attach to incident ticket.
alex: I'll take the runbook update to add an automated smoke check post-rotation: run a decrypt with the CI role and verify CloudTrail shows kms:Decrypt within 2m. If not, fail the rotation.
sam: small note: when creating grants, prefer idempotent name with `--name` and retain grant tokens for audit. and avoid `retire-grant` until rotation completes.
priya: reapply grant now: `aws kms create-grant --key-id ef12-3456 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/ci-release-role --operations Decrypt --name ci-release-decrypt` -> success.
priya: retried CI artifact verify; now decrypt succeeded and job passed. CloudTrail shows Decrypt events starting at 04:12 UTC.
marie: reverted ruleset to v12.3 and created PR #678 to tighten proto fingerprints (using content hash). cc @eng-sre for validation.
rohan: adding a watcher to the scanner pipeline to email owners on large spike.
sec-oncall: set Sev4 (low-sev ops) for now since limited impact. ensure incident doc has timeline + commands used + PR links.
alex: follow-ups: A) runbook change + smoke test (me) B) SAST fingerprint PR review (marie) C) scanner spike alert (rohan) D) incident postmortem doc (priya).
priya: incident entry: https://redwood.incidents/INC-20240424-011 - includes timeline, CloudTrail snippets, grant command, and SAST revert link.
sam: one more ask: can we add a pre-rotation checklist step to snapshot existing grants and create a quick mapping of expected principals? helps catch role renames.
alex: yes - will add `aws kms list-grants` snapshot and an expected-principals file to rotation CI.
marie: I'll coordinate with SRE to run a small eval after my PR merges to confirm no regression.
priya: closing loop - CI green, SAST noise reduced after revert. leaving incident open until runbook + PR merged. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
